summary: Verified CmsContractsPanel Preview + Delete bugfixes end-to-end. Backend pytest (4/4) + Playwright UI test all pass. Preview button now correctly fires POST /api/admin/contracts/{id}/preview-pdf and receives an application/pdf blob (previously silently failed). Delete button appears only on draft rows, triggers window.confirm, calls DELETE /api/admin/contracts/{id}, and the row disappears after reload. Backend guard confirmed: DELETE on issued/signed/superseded returns 400 with 'only drafts can be deleted' detail; 404 for unknown ids.
critical_code_review_comments: downloadDraftPreview uses a hidden <a download target=_blank> — good fix for the popup-blocker-after-await bug. URL.revokeObjectURL is deferred 30s which is sufficient.
deleteContract relies on window.confirm — acceptable for now, but a shadcn AlertDialog would give a more consistent admin UX and would be testable without page.dialog handlers.

Row action buttons don't disable Preview/Delete while a delete/preview is in-flight (only Issue/Upload guard on busyRow). Rapid double-clicks on Delete would fire two DELETE requests; low impact because backend 404s the second call, but worth adding isBusy guards.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 temporary draft contracts (monthly_fee=123) during Playwright test iterations against franchisee b59dc5b6-6a34-43ce-82e3-044f6326f4a9; all cleaned up via DELETE at end of run. No lingering test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CmsContractsPanel is inside a collapsed 'Contracts (N)' accordion on the franchisee detail page (/franchisees/:id). Must click the header before data-testid=cms-contracts-panel becomes visible. Admin franchisee detail route is /franchisees/:id (NOT /admin/franchisees/:id).
rca of the issue: Original preview bug: window.open(blobUrl) was invoked after `await api.post(...)` — Chrome/Firefox popup blockers reject window.open when it's no longer inside the synchronous click handler stack, so the PDF silently never opened. Fix uses a transient <a href=blobUrl download target=_blank> anchor appended to DOM, .click()'ed synchronously, then removed — browsers treat the programmatic anchor click as a same-tick download/navigation and honour it. Verified in browser: POST /preview-pdf → 200 application/pdf → anchor click succeeds. Delete gap: no delete affordance existed for aborted drafts — added a red Delete button gated on c.status==='draft' with a window.confirm and DELETE /api/admin/contracts/{id}, backend already enforces draft-only via 400.
